defaults.label: SIMULATION PROXY (waiting/idling only) - estimate, not a measurement
defaults.idle_fuel_rate_status: CONFIGURABLE SIMULATION PARAMETER (not a universal vehicle constant)
defaults.idle_fuel_rate_basis: Default 0.6 L/h = 0.16 gal/h x 3.78541 L/gal = 0.606 L/h, based on published passenger-vehicle idling examples (Argonne National Laboratory 'Idling Reduction Savings Calculator', no load: Ford Focus gasoline 0.16, Volkswagen Jetta diesel 0.17, Ford Crown Victoria gasoline 0.39 gal/h; U.S. DOE general statement about 0.25-0.5 gal/h). Not a calibrated fleet-average value.
defaults.emission_factor_basis: SOURCE-DERIVED: U.S. EPA 8,887 g CO2 per US gallon gasoline (10,180 for diesel), converted at 3.785411784 L per gallon

emission_factor.status: SOURCE-DERIVED, page read for this project
emission_factor.source: U.S. EPA, Greenhouse Gas Emissions from a Typical Passenger Vehicle

idle_fuel_rate.status: CONFIGURABLE SIMULATION PARAMETER (not a universal vehicle constant; not a calibrated fleet average)
idle_fuel_rate.default_derivation: 0.16 gal/h x 3.78541 L/gal = 0.606 L/h, rounded to 0.6
idle_fuel_rate.default_choice: the lowest of the published examples, so the proxy does not overstate fuel use

source.title: Idling Reduction Savings Calculator
source.figures_provenance: document title, publisher and URL confirmed; figures supplied to the project by its owner from that worksheet; the PDF text could not be retrieved by the build tooling (HTTP 403), so the figures were not independently re-read there

idle_fuel_rate.doe_general_statement_provenance: general statement supplied to the project; no specific page cited
idle_fuel_rate.sensitivity_values_meaning: scenario parameters spanning the examples and the DOE range, not vehicle characteristics

not_modelled: fuel used while moving or in transit
environmental_proxy.statement: SIMULATION PROXY - NOT A MEASUREMENT. The environmental model uses a configurable waiting/idling fuel-rate proxy. The default is based on published passenger-vehicle idling examples and is not a calibrated fleet-average value. Fuel and CO2 are linear in the simulator's waiting vehicle-seconds; they are not measurements and not calibrated real-world estimates.

experiment.start_state: state after 30 fixed-time cycles (Phase 3/4), or the synthetic jam for downstream_congested
experiment.qaoa: plans SAVED by Phase 4 (seed 0 only); QAOA not rerun
